title: Sub 8.4kg Gravel Bike for Under ₱90,000 — Full Build Breakdown

takeaways.text: His build (L-TWOO GR7 1×, alloy wheels of about 1.6 kg, Kenda 45 mm tires) weighed 8.38 kg; listed part prices totalled about ₱87,600 including the painted frameset at ₱28,500.
He values the round 27.2 mm seatpost and threaded bottom bracket (no proprietary parts) and calls the frame a copy of the Scott Addict Gravel shape.
Kenda Crusher 700×45 mm tires on rims of about 25 mm internal width fitted; he describes the bike as racy but not aggressive.

disclosure: The presenter owns a bike shop that sells the wheel build shown, quoted list rather than paid prices, and the video is sponsored by a coffee brand.
summary: A Philippine shop owner's custom 1× BXT Gravel 135 build with L-TWOO GR7, cost breakdown and first rides; not the candidate's GRX complete build.
